reviews.comment: He is a great professor who is always passionate about helping his students. However, the class structure is not the best, as it is mostly dependent on your ability to perform on exams. But as someone who got an A in the class, it is totally doable. Professor Roy isn't the problem; he is an amazing professor.

Amazing prof! Made statistics super engaging and explained everything in a way that was simple to understand. People may complain about the course being 80% tests but that's out of his control and is the same for the entire stats department I'm pretty sure. He was understanding of his students.

Best professor I have had, no doubt. He advocates for students so much and is a very kind and caring person. He made statistics much more exciting to learn, despite being new to teaching. He was amazing. Absolutely nothing negative to say.

Absolutely amazing Graduate Assistant Lecturer. Advocated for us as students, provided additional resources that he clearly put a lot of time and care into, and was incredibly easy to access outside of class. Overall, a very kind and enthusiastic individual. I wish all professors were like him.
